anomalies.message: CPU load average is significantly higher than the number of cores, indicating potential overutilization or bottleneck.
No active or closed trades, and trading metrics such as totalPL, winRate, and ROI are all zero, which is unusual for a trading platform.
AI system has not performed any recent learning cycles or generated opportunities, which may indicate a malfunction or misconfiguration.

optimizations.recommendation: Investigate and optimize CPU-intensive processes to reduce load and improve system responsiveness.
Review and potentially update trading strategies to ensure they are functioning correctly and generating trades.
Evaluate AI system configuration and ensure it is set up to perform learning cycles and generate trading opportunities.

recommendations.action: Conduct a thorough investigation of the CPU load to identify and resolve any processes causing excessive usage.
recommendations.rationale: High CPU load can lead to system instability and degraded performance, impacting overall platform reliability.

recommendations.action: Audit current trading strategies and AI configurations to ensure they are operational and aligned with market conditions.
recommendations.rationale: Ensuring trading strategies and AI systems are functioning correctly is crucial for maintaining platform profitability and competitiveness.

recommendations.action: Implement monitoring and alerting for trading activity and AI performance to quickly identify and address any future issues.
recommendations.rationale: Proactive monitoring can help prevent prolonged downtime or missed trading opportunities, enhancing platform reliability.
